## TrainGuard · n8n orquesta, MCP entrena
1. Bridge: `python -m trainguard.bridge.app`
2. Túnel: `ngrok http 8787`
3. Webhook:
```json
{
  "mode": "demo",
  "kind": "nan_loss",
  "dataset": "auto",
  "bridge_base_url": "https://TU-URL.ngrok-free.app"
}
```
`dataset`: `auto` | `mnist` | `fashion_mnist` | `cifar10` | `custom`
`dataset_path`: `data/custom/mi_set`
`dataset_url`: ZIP ImageFolder (http/s)

`auto` usa la primera carpeta en `data/custom/` o MNIST.
Modes: `demo` | `analyze` | `inject`
Faults: `nan_loss` | `exploding_lr` | `stall`
